narr: Monsoonal moisture remained over the region with a low level convergent area setting up near the New Mexico/Arizona border region. A strong thunderstorm developed over the Lordsburg Playa and produced heavy rain and areas of blowing dust reducing visibilities to under a quarter mile.
ev: The Emergency Manager reported flash flooding on Interstate 10 westbound where water was running across the lanes.
lsr: I-10 westbound lanes have water running across them, but passable.
